allow ns-lz-hub.secattr-mgmt:mgmt01 endpoints in ns-lz-hub.secattr-vcn:hub-vcn01 VCN to connect to ns-lz-preprod-proj.secattr-generic:generic01 endpoints in ns-lz-preprod-proj.secattr-vcn:proj-vcn01 VCN
